name: Digitakt II
summary: OS 1.17 support and Perform Direct are in review. Verify your original OS file locally; builds will follow after qualification.

research.label: elekloader — Digitakt II support by toonst
research.note: OS 1.17 sealed writer, exact stock rebuild and core hooks; emulator checks and a Perform Direct hardware build reported upstream. These are author reports, not Modwerk qualification.

research.label: digikit
research.note: Emulator for the control processor that boots the real OS and shows its screen, plus analysis tools for the audio processor and the sealed OS file.

firmware.flash: The author reports an in-OS upgrade with Elektron Transfer over USB. Modwerk builds remain pending qualification.
firmware.recovery: Hold FUNC while powering on, press TRIG 4 for OS UPGRADE, and send the original .syx over MIDI ports, not USB.

sdk.toolchain: m68k-elf GCC and binutils for ColdFire, with the pinned elekloader builder in a local sandbox. Pending source is excluded from CI.

budgets.name: Shared mod memory
budgets.note: Upstream DDR 0x47F00000–0x47F40000, shared by core and mods; qualification remains pending.

budgets.name: Fast SRAM for code
budgets.note: Upstream SRAM tail 0x8000F100–0x80010000; copied by core on the first ev_tick. Key/encoder handlers must remain in DDR.
